title: Fixed Dimensions
goal: Match the array parameter type and shorthand initializer.
hints: Array types require both element type and element count.
The function indexes three elements, so the type and call site must match length 3.
explanation: In Rust, length is part of the array type. `[i32; 3]` describes an array of three `i32` values. Writing `[i32]` without a length produces error `E0277` because slice types do not have a fixed size known at compile time. Matching `[i32; 4]` against `[i32; 3]` causes `E0308` type mismatch.
